• General Information
  • Volumes

This is a list of all current chapters of One Piece, arranged by volume. Both chapters and volumes are listed with appropriate titles, comprising the original Japanese text, romaji transcriptions, and English translations.

(Note: The "US" title of each volume reflects the titles chosen by VIZ Media for its officially-licensed English adaptation of the manga, and may not necessarily be a direct translation of the Japanese title.)
